whatsOn.title: Quiz nights
whatsOn.detail:
We run a regular quiz night once a fortnight! It's free to enter and a maximum of five per team allowed (if you have more, you can still take part, but just can't win!)
This is a very well attended quiz so booking is essential. Please get in touch to book your team in!

quiz.intro:

food.fridayPizza:
Tiago’s Pizza truck is a traditional Italian wood fired pizza truck and is with us every Friday from  4.30pm till 9pm. You are welcome to eat in he pub with a drink or take away to the comfort of your own home!
Please note that all pizza's are handcrafted and cooked to order and on busy nights, wait times can be up to one hour.
This is a family run business and regular holidays are taken in the summer holidays, half terms and Easter and Christmas holidays so please check our social media pages for dates they are away
